Borders

Utilities for border width, color, direction, and border radius to frame and separate interface elements.

Border Width

Control border width from 0 to 4px using the border utility classes.

Width
border-0
border (1px)
border-2
border-4
css 
.zak-border   { border: 1px solid var(--zak-border); }
.zak-border-0 { border: 0; }
.zak-border-2 { border: 2px solid var(--zak-border); }
.zak-border-4 { border: 4px solid var(--zak-border); }

Border Direction

Add a border to a single side only — top, end (right), bottom, or start (left).

Directions
border-top
border-end
border-bottom
border-start
css 
.zak-border-top    { border-top: 1px solid var(--zak-border); }
.zak-border-end    { border-right: 1px solid var(--zak-border); }
.zak-border-bottom { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--zak-border); }
.zak-border-start  { border-left: 1px solid var(--zak-border); }

/* Remove individual sides */
.zak-border-top-0 .zak-border-bottom-0
.zak-border-start-0 .zak-border-end-0

Border Radius

Round corners from sharp to fully pill-shaped.

Radius
0
sm
md
lg
xl
2xl
3xl
full
css 
.zak-rounded-0     { border-radius: 0; }
.zak-rounded-sm    { border-radius: 0.25rem; }
.zak-rounded-md    { border-radius: 0.375rem; }
.zak-rounded-lg    { border-radius: 0.5rem; }
.zak-rounded-xl    { border-radius: 0.75rem; }
.zak-rounded-2xl   { border-radius: 1rem; }
.zak-rounded-3xl   { border-radius: 1.5rem; }
.zak-rounded-full  { border-radius: 9999px; }

/* Directional */
.zak-rounded-top .zak-rounded-bottom
.zak-rounded-start .zak-rounded-end

Examples

Real-world border usage on cards, inputs, and buttons.

Components
Header

Card with rounded corners and a bottom-divider header.

html 
<!-- Card -->
<div class="zak-border zak-rounded-lg">...</div>

<!-- Input -->
<input class="zak-border zak-rounded-lg" />

<!-- Buttons -->
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary zak-rounded-full">Pill</button>
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-danger zak-rounded-md">Rounded</button>

Accessibility

  • Use borders to delineate interactive regions; ensure a minimum border contrast of 3:1 against adjacent colors.
  • Never rely on border color alone for state — combine with icons, labels, or background fills.
  • Provide clear visible focus indicators (:focus-visible) on elements that use borders as their default style.
  • For clickable cards, apply the border on the whole card and use a hover state for discoverability.
